headline: Anthropic launches free OSS Scanner for open-source vulnerabilities
summary: Anthropic launched OSS Scanner, a free service that gives open-source projects periodic security scans using its strongest AI models to help find vulnerabilities sooner.

claims.statement: Anthropic launched a free service called OSS Scanner to find security vulnerabilities in open-source projects.

sources.quote: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
Anthropic now offers a free vulnerability-finding service for open-source software
Anthropic is offering open-source projects a new way to check for vulnerabilities with its OSS Scanner.

claims.statement: Opted-in projects get thorough, periodic security scans by Anthropic's strongest models at no cost.

sources.quote: thorough, periodic security scans by our strongest models at no cost
